name: Mercury 2.5
description: Mercury 2.5 is Inception's reasoning diffusion language model for fast, high-quality text generation, coding, and agent workflows. It accepts text inputs and produces text outputs.

details.name: context_length
details.value: 256K tokens (marketed as 260K on Inception's public model page).

details.name: reasoning_effort
details.value: instant, medium, and high; medium is the recommended default.

details.name: max_tokens
details.value: Inception's early-access guidance recommends 8192; max_tokens is shared between internal reasoning and the visible response.

sources.notes: Inception's public model page lists Mercury 2.5 as a preview model with a 260K context window, reasoning, tool use, and structured output.
Official Inception API model and pricing documentation; the public model page supplies the Mercury 2.5-specific metadata.

verification.notes: Metadata and pricing are verified against Inception's public model page. A live Phaseo smoke test remains pending the production provider key and the 2026-09-07 launch window.
